President Donald Trump’s approval rating dropped to the lowest level of his second term in the White House.

In a new Reuters/Ipsos poll, only 33% of Americans in the survey admitted that they approved of Trump's performance in the White House, while 64% disapproved.

Just 33 percent of respondents approved of Trump’s job performance, according to the Reuters/Ipsos poll. The approval rating is the lowest ever during this term and matches the lowest seen in December 2017 during his first term.
